title: English Practice Quiz 0964
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A contract is an agreement that may create ___.
questions.explanation: A contract can create enforceable rights and obligations.

questions.question: A witness is a person who ___.
options: saw an event or can give relevant evidence
questions.explanation: A witness may provide an account of what they observed.

questions.question: A receipt is proof that ___.
options: a payment or transaction was made
questions.explanation: A receipt records details of a transaction or payment.

questions.question: The term 'liable' generally means ___.
questions.explanation: Liable means responsible under the law or an obligation.

questions.question: A 'policy' in an organisation is usually ___.
options: a set of rules or guiding principles
questions.explanation: A policy guides decisions and behaviour within an organisation.

questions.question: An invoice is a document that requests ___.
questions.explanation: An invoice states what is owed for supplied goods or services.

questions.question: A signature on a document is commonly used to ___.
options: show approval or acknowledge the document
questions.explanation: A signature can indicate approval or acknowledgement, depending on the document.

questions.question: A 'breach of contract' occurs when a party ___.
options: fails to meet a contractual obligation
requests a copy of the contract
questions.explanation: A breach is a failure to perform a contractual duty.

questions.question: A business's 'revenue' is the money it ___.
options: earns from its activities before expenses are deducted
questions.explanation: Revenue is income generated by business operations before expenses.

questions.question: A 'refund' is money that is ___.
questions.explanation: A refund returns money previously paid.
